project.name: jawelte tests/jta-module scenario 52: narayana-tm-bootstrap
project.description: Bootstrap smoke test that pins NarayanaTransactionManagerProvider as the active TM via a per-scenario META-INF/services override. narayana-jta is already on the classpath under jta-geronimo (the activeByDefault profile bundles it for the CDI integration), so this scenario runs against Narayana under bare `mvn clean install` and exercises Narayana's create()/userTransaction()/TSR/shutdown/name + the JTAEnvironmentBean seeding path without requiring an explicit -P jta-narayana flag.
